title: Wren and the Silence
author: O. M. Ravensworth
blurb: Isandro Brightwater, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
